title: openai-compat: support Responses v1.1, seed/determinism, metadata passthrough, streaming/tool-call fixes
author: Maya Chen
description: This PR updates the OpenAI compatibility layer to support the Responses API v1.1 surface (including new 'seed' and determinism hints), preserves user-provided metadata through passthrough fields, and fixes several streaming stability and function/tool-calling edge cases. Motivation: customers expect parity with newer OpenAI Responses features for deterministic evaluation, better metadata auditing, and reliable streaming semantics for long-running payloads. Changes include: support for Responses v1.1 parameters (seed, deterministic flags), mapping OpenAI function/tool calling to Redwood internal tool-call hooks, ensuring metadata fields in responses are round-tripped and stored in audit logs, streaming buffer and reconnect improvements to reduce partial-event duplication, and backward-compatible SDK changes for Python/TS. Included tests, docs, and migration notes. Checklist: 1) API mapping and compatibility tests added, 2) streaming e2e stability tests and flaky-case harness, 3) docs and changelog updates, 4) SDK compatibility shims for typed responses, 5) migration notes for Dedicated/Private customers. Related: linear/ENG-4782 for determinism rollout and ENG-4821 for streaming improvements. For reviewers: see CI checks and review threads; there was a transient test flakiness on linux-integration-3 which was rerun and resolved.

notes: Behavior: seed is an optional hint. When set it is forwarded to model runtime and to deterministic evaluation harnesses; when unset behavior is unchanged.
Metadata passthrough: request.metadata fields are copied to response.metadata and persisted to audit logs; SDKs expose response.metadata in typed responses.

Tool/function calling: openai function_call.name is resolved against registered tool registry; unknown tools will surface an event and a helpful error message; tool-call telemetry includes mapping latency.
Streaming: improved buffering and reconnect to reduce duplicated events on network blips; added idempotency check using last-event-id header semantics.
Backward compatibility: default behavior unchanged for older Responses payloads and for consumers using the OpenAI compatibility shim.
Deployment: no cluster downtime expected; feature gated behind compat flag for Dedicated/Private customers during staged rollout.
release_notes: Added OpenAI Responses v1.1 compatibility: seed/determinism support, metadata passthrough, improved streaming stability, and function/tool calling mapping. SDKs updated with compatibility shims and docs updated with migration guidance. No breaking changes expected.
